title: Inside the Corner
summary: A paper act whose verdict is a contrast of plates. Built for sits on an ink plate inside the mark's K1 corner, drawn solid at 1:1 of the master. Not for sits on a quiet paper plate where the same corner is only a ghost. Each plate ends on its own door. Today's HUD gate panel becomes two flat, legible plates you can place yourself in at a glance.

reference.borrowed: T1 Energy's 'Two form factors. / Powerful possibilities.' composition: a two-tone headline whose second line is muted, over two tall contrasting panels side by side, one dark and one light. Each panel carries a title, a small spec label and short copy, with an image filling its lower part. The dark/light inversion does the comparing.
reference.kelwin: The headline becomes A's section head, echoing the hero: red-square caps label 'WHO IT’S FOR' with 'Qualification · strict' in mono at right, then the 96px two-voice 'Not for everyone. / By design.' (light, --fg-2), a 48×2 red rule, a 20px lede in cols 1–6 and a bottom-right annotation ('■ Both directions · If we're not the right instrument, the audit readout says so.'). The rounded photo panels become flat, square plates on the 12-column grid. The dark one becomes the Built-for ink plate (cols 1–7, data-surface dark), and the light one the Not-for paper plate (cols 8–12, --panel), which is narrower to show the hierarchy. The photos are replaced by the mark's K1 corner (top bar 152×45 + right bar 44×152, drawn at 1:1) flush to each plate's top-right. It is solid --soft on the ink plate (installed) and a --panel-2 ghost on the paper plate (nothing installed). The panel copy becomes hairline strips sharing row heights across both plates, so each pair reads straight across: a mono index, a 30px wide title (medium voice inside, light voice outside) and a 15px reason. The plates end on the two doors: the red tracked-caps 'Request a System Audit ↗' under 'Sound like you?', and the underlined 'Talk to the team →' under 'Not sure which side?'.

motion: entrance: the label fades in (300ms). 'Not for everyone.' then the light 'By design.' rise out of masks (800ms --ease-out, about 220ms apart). The 48×2 red rule draws, and the lede and annotation fade up 12px.

the plates: the ink plate wipes open left to right (900ms --ease-inout) and the paper plate fades in. The plate heads appear, then each pair of rows lands together: its hairline draws and its index, title and reason fade up (600ms, 120ms stagger). The ghost corner fades into the paper plate.

the one orchestrated moment, at about 2.5s: the solid K1 corner slides into the ink plate's top-right from outside the plate (700ms --ease-out, translate 48px). This is the 'installed' beat. Then both doors come up (600ms).

interaction: hovering a Not-for row raises its light title from --fg-2 to --fg. On CTA hover the fill goes to --accent-hover and the ↗ moves 2px up-right. The secondary link's underline goes from --line-2 to --fg.
on the live site: the plate sequence runs once when the plates are 50% in view. Reduced motion shows the final state with the corner seated.
notes: Fit has no numbered FIG (only figures are numbered; method is FIG. 07 and assets FIG. 08). The corner is therefore an unnumbered plate detail, not a figure, and is not labelled as the logo (only K1 is drawn). Rows share a subgrid, so pairs align across plates (Pre-revenue | Lead-list shopping | Pure self-serve / PLG are reordered to mirror their Built-for pair). Height is about 1250px, above the 1100 aim and inside the 1400 cap, because both plates carry full source sentences. The previous version (a bare Ploy-style two-column table) was rebuilt: it read as a generic comparison table and was too close to option C's mirrored spec tables. Coherence pass: label renamed 'Who it’s for' to match A's label voice; reasons set at 15px body. Direction-coherence pass: A's one section rhythm is 112px top / 96px bottom in the render (160/160 on the live site); the head grammar is the hero's — Mona 500 11px tracked-caps label with an 8px red square (mono FIG. number at right), 96px two-voice statement on the display tokens with exactly one light phrase, 48×2 red rule, 20px lede in cols 1–6 (≤ 50ch, ≤ 3 lines), optional quiet door, and the founder's bottom-right annotation; FIG. numbers run 01–11 in homepage order; segmented controls are 11px tracked caps.
